# Outreach volunteers check-in, 2026-02-05

Quarterly check-in with volunteers for the [[Hearthside Visits|homebound service]].

## Choosing titles

Volunteers said the hardest part is guessing what a patron wants to read next. Several now keep a short card for each patron with authors they liked, authors they did not, and print size. Wendeline will add a reading history printout to each bag, and [[How to prepare a visit bag#Choosing titles]] will describe the card.

## Other notes

- Two patrons moved into care facilities and left the program.
- Winter visits slipped by a week during the January ice storm.
- Volunteers asked for a second audiobook player model that is easier to use; see [[How to prepare a visit bag#Audiobook players]].
